igname_irrigation_001 : fréquence d'arrosage à valider agronomiquement

corrections.igname_conseil_001: Ka ku sɔrɔ caman, aw ye dugukolo labɛn ka ɲɛ. Ku bɛ bɔ ka ɲɛ dugukolo nɔgɔman na. Aw ye tugunw kɛ ka kuw bonya dɛmɛ.
corrections.igname_saison_001: Ku sɛnɛ tuma ɲuman ye Zanviye kalo ni Marisi kalo cɛ. Sanjiii bɛ na o tuma la. Sisan, aw ye tugunw labɛn ka aw yɛrɛ labɛn.
corrections.igname_recolte_001: Sɛnɛli kɔfɛ kalo wolonfila ni kɔnɔntɔn cɛ, ku tigɛ tuma ye. Ni furaw bɛ ja, tigɛ tuma ɲuman ye. Aw ye kuw sogi dɔɔni dɔɔni, aw kana u tiɲɛ.
corrections.igname_irrigation_001: Ku bɛ ji fɛ caman a bonya daminɛ tuma la. Ni sanjiii tɛ, aw ye ji don siɲɛ kelen tile o tile. Aw kana ji caman don; kuw bɛ toli o la.
corrections.igname_engrais_001: Ku sɛnɛ la, aw ye nɔgɔ bɔlen don dugukolo la sani ka tugunw kɛ. Kalo fila kɔ, aw ye NPK dɔɔni fara a kan. Azɔti caman bɛ furaw caya, nga kuw tɛ bonya ka ɲɛ.
corrections.igname_stockage_001: Ku bɛ se ka to kalo saba ka se wɔɔrɔ ma. Aw ye u mara suma la, yɔrɔ jalen min na fiɲɛ bɛ. Aw kana u ko sani ka u mara.
corrections.igname_vente_001: Ku fere ka ɲi tigɛli kɔfɛ joona. Aw ye taa lɔgɔ la sɔgɔma joona. Aw ye ku ɲumanw sugandi fere kama.
corrections.igname_diagnostic_001: Ku bɛ se ka toli, walima furaw bɛ kɛ kalakala ye. Ni aw ye ku magamanw ye, aw ye u bɔ joona. Aw ye ANADER sɛnɛbaga weele ka aw dɛmɛ.
